title: Adopt scheduling-time, estimation and research packs on release
goal: New general packs reach NERV's campaign when gauntlet-protocol tags them
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "ok to all" (accepts proposal from solution:F-016, docs/reviews/2026-11-shared-assets/gauntlet-nerv.md); same message: "nerv and all modules will need to work with Italian".
When gauntlet-protocol tags scheduling-time-v1, estimation-v1 or research-v1 (F-023-T02, F-024-T02, F-025-T02) the pin moves and the pack runs in the next owner-approved campaign
Each pack run includes its Italian cases (owner 2026-11-26); if a release has none, a gauntlet-protocol record is opened for them
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens, private channel IDs or personal data in Git.
escalation: The first model run and any --allow-models run need the owner (human action); a material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: From solution:F-016-T03 proposal 4; 0.5 h agent per release; Italian phrasings are part of every case set (owner 2026-11-26): each capability has Italian and English requests. Not a measurement.
